provenance: Original procedural targets authored for MoGen in 2026; source and derived reference renders CC0-1.0. These are diagnostic fixtures, not AI baseline results.

tasks.prompt: A walnut chair, 0.6m wide and approximately 1m tall, with four legs, a broad back and two spherical finials. Preserve all eight named parts. Ornament should match the reference without inventing animation.
A warm linen cushion on a dark wooden ottoman frame, 1m wide, 0.8m deep, about 0.42m tall. The cushion must bulge at its middle and taper at its top and bottom; avoid a plain box.
A hollow turquoise ceramic vessel, 0.5m tall, maximum diameter 0.44m, narrowed neck and visible interior wall. Keep an open mouth and closed base.
A steel shaft support assembly, 1m base width, with raised support, horizontal shaft and handwheel. Match the reference joints and negative space; static geometry only.
A green continuous pear-like organic form, roughly 0.6m wide and 0.8m tall, merging its upper lobe smoothly into the body. Match silhouette without adding limbs or animation.
A small table scene on a 2m square floor, with a pedestal table, clay pot and closed book resting on the tabletop. Tabletop height about 0.69m. Keep each prop separately editable.
